name: agent-os
description: A lightweight agent operating system with explicit workflows and automatic disciplines, shared between Claude Code and Codex.

interface.longDescription: Charts broad work as decision tickets, shapes bounded work into decision-complete specs, batches independent ready units through isolated workers, and delivers against developer-defined outcomes and boundaries. Agents choose reversible implementation details inside those bounds while automatic disciplines keep them reproducing before patching, controlling scope, and proving completion claims with fresh evidence.
